Magician Controls

Use this secretly before or during performance. Arm the break manually or automatically after a number of spectator presses.

Manual arm
Next press becomes the broken press.
Secret lower-right hold
Press and hold the lower-right corner for 2.2 seconds. The next two presses work; the third breaks.
